items.caption: BOOM — royal-blue to navy gradient, marigold beveled wordmark with chrome highlights. Hood-up hero, original yellow blob glyph on the chest, red lollipop at mouth level. Three vinyl-star stickers (lollipop macro, blob face, pixel NEW DROP).

DANG — coral-to-plum sunset gradient, mint-green wordmark. Box-braids hero in a varsity jacket, original cyclops-cloud chest glyph, dripping twin-stick popsicle. Same fixed layout, fully swapped palette / hero / product.

YIKES — lime-to-forest gradient, hot-pink wordmark. Bleached-buzzcut hero in a retro tracksuit + round shades, original lopsided star glyph, plain unbranded soda can. Demonstrates the scaffold survives a third hard palette / aesthetic swing.
